title: Train a tiny GPT in PyTorch
hints: Block = x + attn(ln1(x)), then x + mlp(ln2(x)). Keep a tril buffer for the causal mask and masked_fill(~tril, -inf) before the softmax. If you use nn.MultiheadAttention(batch_first=True), its attn_mask is True where attention is NOT allowed, and pass need_weights=False.
Loss: F.cross_entropy(logits.reshape(-1, V), y.reshape(-1), ignore_index=-100). make_batch already sets the digits-and-separator positions of y to -100.

AdamW at lr 1e-3 with batch 64 and gradient clipping at 1.0 solves this in a few hundred steps. Initialise Linear and Embedding weights with std 0.02, zero the biases, and tie lm_head.weight = tok_emb.weight.
